build_moriio_config: build a MoRIIOConfig from a VllmConfig to get local IP, ports, and parallel ranks for KV transfer
create_zmq_socket_ctx: create a ZMQ socket context manager for ROUTER, REQ, or DEALER socket types with automatic cleanup
manage_role_state: manage the singleton role state (PRODUCER, CONSUMER, NOTINIT) across the MoRIIO connector
add_kv_transfer_request: add a new KV transfer request to MoRIIOConnectorMetadata for send or receive with block IDs and remote engine info
get_moriio_transfer_mode: get the MoRIIO transfer mode (READ or WRITE) from the VLLM_MORIIO_CONNECTOR_READ_MODE environment variable
